p: Cargo Express ehf. (kt. {kennitala}), Ármúli 8a, 108 Reykjavík, Iceland (“Cargo Express”, “we”) is the controller of the personal data described in this policy. We process personal data in line with the Icelandic Act on Data Protection and the Processing of Personal Data, No. 90/2018, and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Questions about this policy: {info} or +354 527 0222.
Visitors to cargoexpress.is, people who send us a quote request, and contact persons at our customers, airlines, agents and suppliers.
Quote requests: company, email address, shipment details (route, pieces, dimensions, weight, ready date, commodity, special handling) and your message.
Business contacts: name, company, job title, email address and phone number, and the content of our emails and calls.
Shipments and invoicing: names and contact details of shippers, consignees and contact persons that appear on air waybills, bookings and invoices.
Website visits: our hosting provider records technical data such as IP address, browser type and the pages requested, to deliver the website and protect it against abuse.
We don't ask for sensitive personal data. Please don't include it in the form.

sections.h: Why we use it, and on what legal basis
p: To answer quote requests and prepare offers: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
To book, carry out and invoice shipments: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).
To keep accounting records: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) under the Icelandic Bookkeeping Act, No. 145/1994.
To stay in touch with business contacts, and to run and secure our website and systems: our legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)).
We don't sell personal data, don't use it for advertising, and don't make decisions about you by automated means.
Only as needed for the purposes above:
Airlines, handling agents, customs authorities and overseas agents, to carry out a shipment.

Service providers who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements: our website host (Netlify), email and office software (Microsoft 365) and our IT service provider (Wise lausnir ehf.).
Public authorities, when the law requires it.

When a shipment goes to a country outside the European Economic Area (EEA), the details needed to deliver it are shared with the airline and agents there, as this is necessary to carry out the contract. Where a service provider processes data outside the EEA, we make sure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as an adequacy decision of the European Commission or its standard contractual clauses.
Quote requests that don't lead to a shipment: deleted within 12 months. Form submissions are removed from the website host within 3 months.
Shipment and invoicing records: 7 years from the end of the financial year, as the Bookkeeping Act requires.
Business contact details: as long as we work together, and deleted when no longer needed.
Website technical logs: kept for a limited period by our hosting provider.

This website doesn't use cookies for tracking or advertising. If we add visitor statistics in the future, we will use a tool that doesn't use cookies or identify individual visitors, and update this policy.
We protect personal data with access controls, secure sign-in and encrypted connections (HTTPS). Only staff who need the data for their work can access it.
You have the right to:
see the personal data we hold about you and get a copy of it;
have incorrect data corrected;
have data deleted when we no longer need it or have no legal basis to keep it;
have processing restricted in certain cases;
receive data you gave us in a commonly used format (data portability);
object to processing based on our legitimate interests.
Write to {info}. We reply within one month. If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to Persónuvernd, the Icelandic Data Protection Authority (www.personuvernd.is).
We may update this policy. The current version is always on this page, with the date it was last updated at the top.
